items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: "I missed Elvis... I used to say wow if I ever got to play with Aretha Franklin... then I said yeah I pretty much did it, Sinatra and Elvis. You know I missed them."

ctx.x: The last quote is something you said during a 2009 CBS interview. “I think I’ve done it you know, I missed Elvis, I missed Sinatra, but otherwise I did pretty well.”

Well someone had asked who do you wish you had gotten to play for. And I get asked still quite often, and that was my answer. But pretty much when I got to play for Aretha, you know that was huge for me. Momentous. Because I used to say wow if I ever got to play with Aretha Franklin. Once I knocked her off and got to play for her a number of times, even produce her doing “Respect” for the Blues Brothers sequel, then I said yeah I pretty much did it, Sinatra and Elvis. You know I missed them. But otherwise did…

Well this has been fantastic and I include myself in that group of envious musicians when we think about what you’ve accomplished and what you’re still — by the way, like when we wrap up here do you have a musical task to take care of?
